title: Powers and duties.
bodyText: The department of health shall enforce this part and shall have, in connection therewith, all the powers and duties conferred and imposed upon it pursuant to part I.
bodyHtml: [§328-105]  Powers and duties.  The department of health shall enforce this part and shall have, in connection therewith, all the powers and duties conferred and imposed upon it pursuant to part I. [L 1996, c 209, pt of §1]
